title: Apartment Electrical Second Fix
activity: Apartment electrical second fix: accessories, lighting, boards, AV/IT and controls
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: All points cut out and cables accessible?
Putty pads fitted in every back box in fire and separating walls (triple boxes too)?
Ask the fitter: Which drawing did you set these accessories out from? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Sockets and switches square, level, at the set-out height and tight to the wall?
Kitchen grid switch and hob switch fitted?
Ceiling fittings secure, LED cove/strip aligned, drivers accessible?
Smoke detectors fitted with their covers on during works?
Main bonding clamps within 600 mm of the service entry, labelled "Safety electrical connection"?
Consumer unit level, circuits match the DB chart, locked off?
KNX keypads/touch panels mounted level and working?
Data outlets, AV faceplates and TV brackets fitted, aligned and labelled?
In-ceiling speakers fitted flush and aligned?
Comms rack level and secure, patch panels labelled, cables dressed?

notOk.t: Sockets and switches not level, not equal height, wonky
Face plates missing or wrong type
LEDs and drivers not fitted / not working
Accessories not labelled with circuit ID
Setting out not from the frozen small power elevation

ask.q: Where is the main bonding clamp and how is it labelled?
ask.a: Within 600 mm of the service entry, labelled 'Safety electrical connection – do not remove'.

ask.q: Have you tested this circuit yet, and where are the results?
ask.a: Yes – on the test schedule for this apartment, before energising.

ask.q: Who checked the device positions against the latest EPR drawing?
ask.a: The supervisor, against the current revision – they can say which.
